Google Career Certificates through Coursera

IT, data, business and other certificate bundles can be considered for transfer. Some current ACE records end November 30, 2026; check renewal and the intended completion date.

Build my degree plan

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Self-paced. Google estimates several months of part-time work; labs, projects and prior knowledge affect effort.
Pricing
Google advertises $49/month in the US/Canada; region, subscription choice and program inclusion can change the amount. Verify checkout.
Assessments
Credential-specific quizzes, labs and projects. Complete the required full credential and obtain the appropriate official record; no universal proctoring claim is made.
Credit type
ACE recommendations for designated completed certificates and versions, not every Google course or Coursera subscription.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
